items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 服务中的远程代码执行漏洞会破坏关键名称解析功能，并可被用于实施大规模网络入侵。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Compressed Folder component permits remote code execution through the processing of malicious archives.
items.reason_zh: Compressed Folder 组件中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过处理恶意归档文件实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in BitLocker may expose sensitive cryptographic metadata, posing a risk to disk encryption integrity and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: BitLocker 中的越界读取漏洞可能泄露敏感加密元数据，对磁盘加密完整性和数据机密性构成风险。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in the IKE Extension causes remote denial of service, effectively disrupting secure VPN and IPsec tunnel establishment.
items.reason_zh: IKE Extension 中的空指针解引用漏洞会导致远程拒绝服务，有效破坏安全 VPN 和 IPsec 隧道的建立。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in the Windows Kernel allows local privilege escalation, granting attackers ring-0 access to bypass standard security controls.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的释放后使用漏洞允许本地权限提升，使攻击者获得 Ring-0 访问权限以绕过标准安全控制。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Bluetooth Service could be exploited locally to escalate privileges by manipulating shared resource synchronization mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Bluetooth Service 中的竞争条件漏洞可能被本地利用，通过操纵共享资源同步机制实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the IKE Extension enables remote code execution by exploiting malformed network packets during handshake negotiation.
items.reason_zh: IKE扩展中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过利用握手协商期间的畸形网络包实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: External path control in Skype for Business enables unauthenticated remote code execution, posing a direct threat to end-user workstations.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business的外部路径控制漏洞可启用未认证的远程代码执行，直接威胁终端用户工作站。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Visual Studio allows network-based code execution, compromising developer environments and internal build pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio中的堆溢出漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，危及开发环境和内部构建流水线。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Microsoft Edge permits local privilege escalation, undermining browser sandbox isolation and user account security.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge中的竞争条件漏洞可导致本地权限提升，破坏浏览器沙箱隔离机制和用户账户安全。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification flaw in Windows RDP Client risks information disclosure during remote administrative sessions.
items.reason_zh: Windows RDP客户端的加密签名验证缺陷可能导致远程管理会话期间发生信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation enables unauthenticated network code execution via malicious media payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意媒体载荷实现未认证的网络代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write during PDF parsing in pdfforge PDF Architect enables remote code execution, requiring only user interaction to open malicious files.
items.reason_zh: pdfforge PDF Architect在解析PDF时的越界写入漏洞可触发远程代码执行，仅需用户交互打开恶意文件即可利用。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption vulnerability in PDF file parsing allows arbitrary code execution on desktop systems upon opening crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: PDF文件解析过程中的内存损坏漏洞可在打开构造的文档后导致桌面系统上的任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: CrowdStrike Falcon sensor policy flaw allows potential privilege escalation or bypass when specific macro removal settings are enabled, directly impacting endpoint security posture.
items.reason_zh: CrowdStrike Falcon传感器策略缺陷在启用特定宏移除设置时可能导致权限提升或策略绕过，直接影响端点安全态势。

items.reason_en: PackageKit skips polkit authorization for simulated transactions, enabling local attackers to escalate privileges by tricking the backend into executing real operations.
items.reason_zh: PackageKit对模拟事务跳过polkit授权，使本地攻击者可通过欺骗后端执行实际操来实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Environment-modules allows local shell metacharacter injection via maliciously named modulefiles, compromising systems relying on bash completion for command execution.
items.reason_zh: Environment-modules允许通过恶意命名的modulefile文件注入本地Shell元字符，危及依赖bash补全执行命令的系统。

items.reason_en: This critical FreeRDP vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass server-side protocol policies and establish RDSTLS connections, enabling unauthorized remote desktop access.
items.reason_zh: 该关键FreeRDP漏洞允许未认证的攻击者绕过服务器端协议策略并建立RDSTLS连接，从而实现未经授权的远程桌面访问。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the RDP negotiation handler can be triggered by malicious servers, potentially leading to remote code execution on affected clients.
items.reason_zh: RDP协商处理程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可由恶意服务器触发，可能导致受影响客户端发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Ghostscript's JPEG 2000 PDF output adapter contains a heap-based buffer overflow triggered by mismatched component subsampling factors, enabling memory corruption via crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: Ghostscript的JPEG 2000 PDF输出适配器存在因组件子采样因子不匹配触发的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的文档实现内存损坏。

items.reason_en: The UEFI Firmware Parser fails to validate bit-length values during Tiano decompression, leading to heap corruption when processing crafted firmware bitstreams.
items.reason_zh: UEFI Firmware Parser在Tiano解压缩过程中未能验证位长值，在处理构造的固件比特流时将导致堆损坏。

items.reason_en: Red Hat GIMP's ICO file loader contains an integer overflow during buffer size calculation, causing a heap-based buffer overflow when decoding embedded PNG images.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat GIMP的ICO文件加载器在计算缓冲区大小时存在整数溢出漏洞，解码嵌入的PNG图像时会引发基于堆的缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Duplicati for Windows incorrectly assigns permissions to its configuration loader, allowing local low-privileged attackers to escalate privileges to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.
items.reason_zh: Windows版Duplicati为其配置加载器错误分配了权限，允许本地低权限攻击者将权限提升至NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in CIFS client prepath sanitization may leak kernel memory or trigger crashes when parsing malformed SMB paths.
items.reason_zh: CIFS客户端预路径清理过程中的越界读取漏洞在解析畸形SMB路径时可能导致内核内存泄露或触发崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unquoted DHCP options in dracut allow adjacent network attackers to inject commands into the boot environment, compromising system initialization.
items.reason_zh: dracut中未加引号的DHCP选项允许相邻网络攻击者向启动环境注入命令，危及系统初始化过程。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation risk where openvt incorrectly validates terminal ownership via symlinks, allowing unprivileged users to spawn privileged sessions.
items.reason_zh: openvt通过符号链接错误验证终端所有权，存在权限提升风险，允许无特权用户生成特权会话。

items.reason_en: World-writable socket and missing signature checks in Parallels' root daemon allow local users to escalate privileges and install virtual appliances.
items.reason_zh: Parallels根守护进程中存在全局可写套接字及缺失的签名检查漏洞，允许本地用户提升权限并安装虚拟设备。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Zscaler Client Connector's tunnel handler causes heap corruption, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution on Windows endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Zscaler Client Connector隧道处理程序中的竞争条件会导致堆损坏，可能在Windows端点上引发任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.2 vulnerability in Oracle Mobile Application Server allows unauthenticated HTTP attacks on terminal servers, risking mobile workforce device security and data leakage.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Mobile Application Server中CVSS评分为8.2的漏洞允许对终端服务器发起未认证的HTTP攻击，危及移动办公设备的网络安全与数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: High-severity (8.1) flaw enables unauthenticated TCP exploitation of the MWA Terminal Server, potentially compromising mobile enterprise applications and field operations.
items.reason_zh: 高严重性（8.1）漏洞可利用未认证的TCP攻击MWA Terminal Server，可能危及移动企业应用和现场作业。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 vulnerability affects mobile terminal server access via physical segments, requiring immediate patching to secure field-deployed handheld devices and networks.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分为7.5的漏洞影响通过物理网段访问的移动终端服务器，需立即修补以保护现场部署的手持设备和网络。

items.reason_en: BlueZ stack-based buffer overflow enables remote code execution upon malicious Bluetooth pairing, posing a direct threat to mobile and IoT device connectivity.
items.reason_zh: BlueZ基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在恶意蓝牙配对时触发远程代码执行，直接威胁移动设备和物联网设备的连接安全。

items.reason_en: Input validation weakness in Zscaler's Android and ChromeOS clients allows attackers to bypass network security controls and route traffic outside the secure tunnel.
items.reason_zh: Zscaler的Android和ChromeOS客户端存在输入验证缺陷，允许攻击者绕过网络安全控制并将流量路由至安全隧道之外。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Netcore router tcpdump utilities allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands with elevated privileges on edge devices.
items.reason_zh: Netcore路由器tcpdump工具中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许攻击者在边缘设备上以高权限执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Netcore CGI endpoints enables remote code execution through crafted form submissions targeting web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Netcore CGI端点存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过针对Web界面的构造表单提交实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing firmware integrity verification in Netcore devices permits loading of unauthorized, potentially malicious firmware images without detection.
items.reason_zh: Netcore设备缺失固件完整性验证机制，允许在未检测的情况下加载未经授权且可能存在恶意的固件镜像。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded credentials in Digital Watchdog surveillance products allow remote attackers to gain root-level FTP access to device storage.
items.reason_zh: Digital Watchdog 监控产品中的硬编码凭据允许远程攻击者获取设备存储的 root 级 FTP 访问权限。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on critical functions in Digital Watchdog devices enables unauthenticated remote command execution as root.
items.reason_zh: Digital Watchdog 设备关键功能缺乏身份验证，导致未认证远程以 root 权限执行命令。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted dangerous file upload in Dell Wyse Management Suite allows remote attackers to achieve remote code execution on managed thin clients.
items.reason_zh: Dell Wyse Management Suite 中不受限制的危险文件上传漏洞允许远程攻击者在受管的瘦客户机上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on critical functions in Dell Wyse Management Suite enables unauthorized access and potential device takeover.
items.reason_zh: Dell Wyse Management Suite 关键功能缺乏身份验证，可导致未授权访问及设备接管风险。

items.reason_en: Totolink router IPv6 setup contains a buffer overflow exploitable remotely, potentially allowing full device compromise and network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: Totolink 路由器 IPv6 配置存在可远程利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致设备完全沦陷及网络横向移动。

items.reason_en: D-Link router disk share configuration suffers from OS command injection, granting attackers unrestricted system control over home and edge network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 路由器磁盘共享配置存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，使攻击者能够完全控制家庭及边缘网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Bambuddy print management system exhibits a fail-open authentication mechanism vulnerable to resource exhaustion attacks, bypassing access controls entirely.
items.reason_zh: Bambuddy 打印管理系统存在故障开放的身份验证机制，易受资源耗尽攻击影响，从而完全绕过访问控制。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file write in the WAVLINK router's sync_server daemon allows remote attackers to overwrite critical system files and achieve full device compromise.
items.reason_zh: WAVLINK 路由器的 sync_server 守护进程存在未认证任意文件写入漏洞，允许远程攻击者覆盖关键系统文件并实现设备完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: A hardcoded HS256 JWT signing key shared across all Issabel PBX installations enables unauthenticated attackers to forge valid bearer tokens and seize administrative control.
items.reason_zh: 所有 Issabel PBX 实例共享的硬编码 HS256 JWT 签名密钥，使未认证攻击者能够伪造有效的 Bearer Token 并夺取管理控制权。

items.reason_en: D-Link DI-8400 suffers a stack-based buffer overflow in its DDNS configuration CGI endpoint, enabling remote attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DI-8400 的 DDNS 配置 CGI 接口存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，使远程攻击者能够实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Totolink A3002MU experiences a buffer overflow in the boafrm component when processing manipulated IPv6 addresses, allowing remote exploitation on IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: Totolink A3002MU 在处理篡改的 IPv6 地址时，boafrm 组件会发生缓冲区溢出，导致物联网网关面临远程利用风险。

items.reason_en: D-Link DWR-M921 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in its disk formatting CGI, permitting remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DWR-M921 的磁盘格式化 CGI 接口存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure AD B2C allows privilege escalation over the network, directly threatening cloud identity management and multi-tenant security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Azure AD B2C 中的权限绕过漏洞允许通过网络提升权限，直接威胁云身份管理及多租户安全边界。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language enables unauthorized network access and potential service abuse by external actors seeking to manipulate AI endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Language 缺乏身份验证，可导致未授权的网络访问及外部实体为操纵 AI 端点而滥用服务的风险。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification flaws in Copilot Studio could allow attackers to tamper with AI-generated outputs or escalate privileges within cloud-hosted development environments.
items.reason_zh: Copilot Studio 中的加密签名验证缺陷可能使攻击者篡改 AI 生成内容，或在云托管开发环境中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication flaw enables unauthorized privilege escalation within cloud-native Java applications deployed on Azure infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证不当缺陷可导致部署于 Azure 基础设施的云原生 Java 应用发生未授权权限提升。

items.reason_en: Command injection vulnerability in the Azure CLI allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands remotely via manipulated configuration inputs.
items.reason_zh: Azure CLI 的命令注入漏洞允许攻击者通过篡改的配置输入远程执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Code injection flaw in the Dynamics 365 platform allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, risking tenant data integrity and business workflows.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 平台的代码注入缺陷允许已认证攻击者执行任意代码，危及租户数据完整性及业务流程。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the managed big data service permits privilege escalation, potentially allowing attackers to pivot within cloud clusters.
items.reason_zh: 托管大数据服务中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许权限提升，可能导致攻击者在云集群内进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Insufficiently protected credentials in the cluster management tool expose sensitive authentication material, increasing the risk of unauthorized cloud resource access.
items.reason_zh: 集群管理工具中凭证保护不足，暴露了敏感认证信息，增加了未授权访问云资源的风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows authenticated users to execute code, undermining enterprise document management and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺乏授权检查，允许已认证用户执行代码，破坏企业文档管理与协作平台的安全。

items.reason_en: Hyper-V heap-based overflow enables local code execution, which can lead to hypervisor escape and compromise multi-tenant cloud or virtualized environments.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 基于堆的溢出漏洞可实现本地代码执行，进而可能导致虚拟机监控程序逃逸，危及多租户云或虚拟化环境。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Entra ID allows privilege escalation over the network, threatening core identity and access management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中缺乏授权检查，允许通过网络提升权限，威胁核心身份与访问管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via alternate channel in Microsoft Entra ID enables unauthenticated privilege escalation across cloud tenant boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 通过备用通道绕过身份验证，可实现跨云租户边界的未认证权限提升。

items.reason_en: Symlink following flaw in Docker Sandboxes on macOS allows guest VMs to escape containers and read or modify arbitrary host filesystems.
items.reason_zh: macOS 上 Docker Sandboxes 的符号链接跟踪缺陷允许访客虚拟机逃逸容器，读取或修改任意主机文件系统。

items.reason_en: Path traversal via symlink replacement in Docker Unix-domain socket relay compromises host-to-guest communication security and isolation.
items.reason_zh: Docker Unix-domain socket 中继中的符号链接替换导致的路径遍历漏洞，破坏了主机到访客的通信安全与隔离性。

items.reason_en: Permissive cross-domain policy in Azure Arc enables unauthorized privilege escalation within hybrid cloud management and orchestration planes.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中过于宽松的跨域策略允许在混合云管理与编排平面中进行未授权权限提升。

items.reason_en: A critical path traversal flaw in Tencent’s cloud-native MSEC allows unauthenticated attackers to gain root access and deploy persistent webshells in cluster environments.
items.reason_zh: 腾讯云原生 MSEC 中存在严重的路径遍历缺陷，允许未认证攻击者获取 root 权限并在集群环境中部署持久化 Webshell。

items.reason_en: Raw getattr exposure in IBM MCP Context Forge's Python sandbox allows complete host compromise, critically impacting AI gateway deployments.
items.reason_zh: IBM MCP Context Forge 的 Python 沙箱中 raw getattr 暴露可导致主机完全沦陷，严重影响 AI 网关部署。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on OpenCost's service key endpoint enables unauthorized submission of arbitrary keys, risking cloud billing data exposure.
items.reason_zh: OpenCost 的服务密钥端点缺乏身份验证，允许未授权提交任意密钥，增加云计费数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable HTTP vulnerability in Oracle Access Manager Authentication Engine allows low-privileged attackers to bypass identity controls.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Access Manager Authentication Engine 中存在易于利用的 HTTP 漏洞，允许低权限攻击者绕过身份控制。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured namespace watching in Strimzi Kafka operators can lead to cross-namespace resource tampering in Kubernetes environments.
items.reason_zh: Strimzi Kafka Operator 中配置错误的命名空间监控可能导致 Kubernetes 环境中的跨命名空间资源篡改。

items.reason_en: IBM Langflow allows arbitrary Python code execution with root privileges and facilitates AWS credential theft via IMDSv1 SSRF, severely compromising cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: IBM Langflow 允许以 root 权限执行任意 Python 代码，并通过 IMDSv1 SSRF 协助窃取 AWS 凭据，严重危及云工作负载安全。

items.reason_en: Docker MCP Gateway improperly marshals OCI image labels, enabling container escape and remote code execution through crafted metadata.
items.reason_zh: Docker MCP Gateway 对 OCI 镜像标签的序列化处理不当，可通过构造元数据实现容器逃逸和远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: GitLab CE/EE permits remote code execution via specially crafted Git project exports that overflow Unicode character limits, affecting major DevOps platforms.
items.reason_zh: GitLab CE/EE 允许通过特制的 Git 项目导出文件溢出 Unicode 字符限制来执行远程代码，影响主流 DevOps 平台。

items.reason_en: Meta Ads MCP server passes attacker-controlled URLs to download functions without validation, enabling SSRF and potential remote code execution in AI-assisted workflows.
items.reason_zh: Meta Ads MCP Server 在未经验证的情况下将攻击者控制的 URL 传递给下载函数，可在 AI 辅助工作流中导致 SSRF 及潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in IBM DataStage allows authenticated attackers to arbitrarily write or delete files on shared PVC storage, breaking multi-tenant isolation and risking data destruction.
items.reason_zh: IBM DataStage 的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证攻击者在共享 PVC 存储上任意写入或删除文件，破坏多租户隔离并导致数据损毁风险。

items.reason_en: The Woodpecker CI Kubernetes backend improperly copies pipeline service account names into pod specifications without sanitization, creating a direct path to container escape or privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Woodpecker CI Kubernetes 后端未进行过滤直接将流水线服务账户名称复制到 Pod 规范中，为容器逃逸或权限提升提供了直接途径。

items.reason_en: PraisonAI exposes unauthenticated API endpoints on 0.0.0.0, allowing remote callers to interact with multi-agent systems without credentials.
items.reason_zh: PraisonAI 在 0.0.0.0 上暴露了未认证的 API 端点，允许远程调用者在无凭据的情况下与多智能体系统交互。

items.reason_en: DevSpace fails to reject parent-directory segments in tar entries from in-pod sync streams, enabling malicious containers to overwrite host files via path traversal.
items.reason_zh: DevSpace 未能拒绝来自 Pod 内同步流的 tar 条目中的父目录路径段，使恶意容器能够通过路径遍历覆盖宿主机文件。

items.reason_en: Polyaxon renders operation specifications with an unsandboxed Jinja2 environment, allowing authenticated users to submit payloads that execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: Polyaxon 使用未沙箱化的 Jinja2 环境渲染操作规范，允许已认证用户提交载荷以执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: rclone's symlink handling allows source .rclonelink objects to plant symlinks in destination directories, potentially bypassing metadata restrictions and accessing unauthorized paths.
items.reason_zh: rclone 的符号链接处理机制允许源 .rclonelink 对象在目标目录中植入符号链接，可能绕过元数据限制并访问未授权路径。

items.reason_en: Kernel virtualization flaw in KVM/nSVM could allow guest-to-host escapes or instability under nested virtualization workloads.
items.reason_zh: KVM/nSVM 的内核虚拟化缺陷可能在嵌套虚拟化工作负载下导致客户机到主机的逃逸或系统不稳定。

items.reason_en: Argument injection flaw in Ansible Galaxy allows malicious role authors to execute arbitrary git commands, compromising CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Ansible Galaxy 的参数注入漏洞允许恶意角色作者执行任意 git 命令，从而破坏 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in KubeSphere's Git integration enables authenticated users to probe internal networks and exfiltrate basic-auth credentials.
items.reason_zh: KubeSphere Git 集成的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许已认证用户探测内部网络并外泄基本认证凭据。

items.reason_en: Predictable named pipe creation in Eclipse Ankaios workload agents enables local privilege escalation or denial of service through filesystem race conditions.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Ankaios 工作负载代理中可预测的命名管道创建机制可通过文件系统竞争条件实现本地权限提升或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in libvirt RPC handler allows unprivileged users to corrupt memory buffers and potentially escalate privileges within hypervisor contexts.
items.reason_zh: libvirt RPC 处理程序中的整数溢出漏洞允许非特权用户破坏内存缓冲区，并可能在虚拟机管理程序上下文中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Critical information disclosure flaw in GitLab's chat feature allows authenticated users to extract instance configurations and sensitive credentials via advanced search.
items.reason_zh: GitLab 聊天功能的关键信息泄露漏洞允许已认证用户通过高级搜索提取实例配置和敏感凭据。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated filename handling in Weights & Biases download function enables path traversal attacks, allowing attackers to write files outside intended directories on shared infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Weights & Biases 下载函数中未验证的文件名处理机制可导致路径遍历攻击，使攻击者能够在共享基础设施上将文件写入预期目录之外。

items.reason_en: Malformed IS-IS LSP packets can prematurely terminate graceful restart procedures on Arista switches, causing significant routing instability and service disruption.
items.reason_zh: 格式错误的 IS-IS LSP 数据包可能导致 Arista 交换机上的优雅重启过程提前终止，引发严重的路由不稳定和服务中断。

items.reason_en: Crafted IS-IS PDUs can purge legitimate link-state database entries, leading to unexpected traffic loss and network partitioning in routed infrastructures.
items.reason_zh: 构造的 IS-IS PDU 可清除合法的链路状态数据库条目，导致路由基础设施中出现意外的流量丢失和网络分区。

items.reason_en: Forged IS-IS Hello PDUs can tear down established adjacencies on broadcast interfaces, disrupting enterprise network connectivity and failover mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 伪造的 IS-IS Hello PDU 可拆除广播接口上已建立的邻接关系，破坏企业网络连接和故障转移机制。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in the Windows iSCSI initiator allows unauthenticated network attackers to bypass security controls and potentially execute code.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 发起程序的弱认证机制允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者绕过安全控制并可能执行代码。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Windows Failover Cluster service enables remote code execution across clustered enterprise storage environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows 故障转移集群服务中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可在集群化企业存储环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Race condition in DNS allows unauthenticated network code execution, threatening core name resolution infrastructure and enabling widespread lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: DNS 中的竞争条件漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者执行代码，威胁核心名称解析基础设施并支持大规模横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly impacting IP address management and network availability.
items.reason_zh: 释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接影响 IP 地址管理和网络可用性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Netlogon service can be exploited remotely to compromise domain controllers and hijack Active Directory authentication.
items.reason_zh: Netlogon 服务的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可被远程利用以攻陷域控制器并劫持 Active Directory 认证。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in the SMB transport driver allows unauthenticated denial of service, disrupting file sharing and inter-server communications.
items.reason_zh: SMB 传输驱动程序中的空指针解引用漏洞允许未经身份验证的拒绝服务攻击，破坏文件共享和服务器间通信。

items.reason_en: DNS use-after-free vulnerability allows unauthenticated network code execution, critically undermining foundational network resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS 释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者执行代码，严重破坏基础网络解析服务。

items.reason_en: Kerberos authentication bypass via capture-replay attacks enables network-wide credential theft and unauthorized lateral movement across Active Directory domains.
items.reason_zh: 通过抓包重放攻击绕过 Kerberos 认证可实现全网凭据窃取，并在 Active Directory 域之间进行未授权的横向移动。

items.reason_en: RPC runtime out-of-bounds write permits unauthenticated network code execution, threatening core distributed computing and inter-process communication protocols.
items.reason_zh: RPC 运行时越界写入漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，威胁核心分布式计算与进程间通信协议。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows DNS Server allows unauthenticated network-based code execution, disrupting critical name resolution and directory services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中的竞态条件允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过执行网络代码，破坏关键的名称解析与目录服务。

items.reason_en: DHCP Option 82 manipulation in Arista EOS enables unauthenticated attackers to spoof client identities and intercept or redirect network traffic.
items.reason_zh: 对 Arista EOS 中 DHCP Option 82 的篡改可使未经身份验证的攻击者伪造客户端身份并拦截或重定向网络流量。

items.reason_en: Compromises the Oracle 5G Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP), potentially disrupting telecom signaling security despite difficult exploitation prerequisites.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞危及 Oracle 5G Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP)，尽管利用条件较为苛刻，但仍可能破坏电信信令安全。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in HPE EdgeConnect SD-WAN Orchestrator API allows low-privileged users to gain administrative control over network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: HPE EdgeConnect SD-WAN Orchestrator API 中的权限提升漏洞使低权限用户能够获取对网络基础设施的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Crafted packets can disrupt authenticated BFD sessions on Arista EOS switches, causing unintended routing protocol failures and network outages.
items.reason_zh: 精心构造的数据包可破坏 Arista EOS 交换机上已认证的 BFD 会话，导致非预期的路由协议故障与网络中断。

items.reason_en: Invalid match offset handling in Red Hat tftp-hpa triggers out-of-bounds memory operations, enabling remote unauthenticated exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat tftp-hpa 中对无效匹配偏移量的处理不当会触发越界内存操作，从而允许远程未经身份验证的攻击者进行利用。

items.reason_en: Remote peers can trigger panics during QUIC handshakes in libp2p-rust, disrupting decentralized networking stack reliability.
items.reason_zh: 远程对等节点可在 libp2p-rust 的 QUIC 握手过程中触发系统崩溃，破坏去中心化网络栈的可靠性。

items.reason_en: HPE EdgeConnect SD-WAN Gateways contain an unauthenticated remote buffer overflow leading to arbitrary code execution, critically impacting enterprise WAN infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: HPE EdgeConnect SD-WAN Gateways 存在未经身份验证的远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致任意代码执行，严重影响企业广域网基础设施。

items.reason_en: HPE EdgeConnect SD-WAN Orchestrator API allows low-privileged users to escalate to administrative rights, compromising centralized network management.
items.reason_zh: HPE EdgeConnect SD-WAN Orchestrator API 允许低权限用户提升至管理员权限，从而危及集中式网络管理。

items.reason_en: goproxy fails to enforce basic authentication on CONNECT tunnel requests, allowing unauthenticated clients to bypass proxy credentials and route traffic freely.
items.reason_zh: goproxy 未在 CONNECT 隧道请求中强制执行基本身份验证，允许未经身份验证的客户端绕过代理凭据并自由路由流量。

items.reason_en: Critical vulnerabilities in Cisco IOS XR address severe flaws in the network operating system that could destabilize core routing infrastructure or enable unauthorized control plane access.
items.reason_zh: Cisco IOS XR 中的严重漏洞涉及网络操作系统的重大缺陷，可能导致核心路由基础设施失稳或允许未经授权的控制平面访问。

items.reason_en: Session fixation in Dell SmartFabric OS10 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack management sessions and gain unauthorized administrative privileges over network switches.
items.reason_zh: Dell SmartFabric OS10 中的会话固定漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者劫持管理会话，并获取网络交换机的未授权管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel netfilter's avx2 matching functions incorrectly return non-matching entries upon expiry, compromising packet filtering integrity and firewall reliability.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 netfilter 的 AVX2 匹配函数在过期后会错误返回不匹配的条目，损害数据包过滤完整性与防火墙可靠性。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel RDMA/iwcm suffers workqueue list corruption due to improper queue submission logic, risking kernel panics or privilege escalation on high-performance networks.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 RDMA/iwcm 因队列提交逻辑不当导致工作队列列表损坏，在高性能网络环境中可能引发内核崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Open5GS triggers a use-after-free vulnerability during old AMF discovery fallback, destabilizing 5G core network functions and enabling potential denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Open5GS 在旧 AMF 发现回退机制中触发释放后使用漏洞，破坏 5G 核心网功能稳定性并可能导致拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Belden Hirschmann HiOS switches contain a denial-of-service flaw in their integrated web server caused by missing HTTP(S) content validation on specific endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Belden Hirschmann HiOS 交换机的集成 Web 服务器存在拒绝服务缺陷，由特定端点缺少 HTTP(S) 内容验证引起。

items.reason_en: High-severity DoS flaw in Netty HTTP/2 implementation allows attackers to crash servers by flooding continuation frames without rate limiting.
items.reason_zh: Netty HTTP/2 实现中存在高危拒绝服务缺陷，攻击者可利用缺乏速率限制的延续帧洪水攻击导致服务器崩溃。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check in IPv6 flowtable offload could lead to resource exhaustion or packet processing failures in high-throughput networks.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 流表卸载中缺少边界检查，可能在高吞吐量网络中导致资源耗尽或数据包处理失败。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in Linux traffic control scheduler could be exploited for privilege escalation or system crashes during packet manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Linux 流量控制调度器中的内存损坏漏洞可能在数据包处理期间被利用，导致权限提升或系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: Critical SCTP state machine flaw allows remote attackers to cause denial of service or disrupt established associations by exploiting stale cookie handling.
items.reason_zh: 严重的 SCTP 状态机缺陷允许远程攻击者利用陈旧 Cookie 处理逻辑导致拒绝服务或破坏已建立的关联。

items.reason_en: Race condition in RDS zerocopy cleanup can lead to use-after-free scenarios, potentially causing kernel crashes or memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: RDS 零拷贝清理过程中的竞态条件可能导致释放后使用漏洞，进而引发内核崩溃或内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited critical flaw in Cisco AsyncOS email parsing allows unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges, severely impacting email security infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Cisco AsyncOS 电子邮件解析中存在正在被积极利用的严重漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者以 root 权限执行远程代码，严重影响电子邮件安全基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on privileged API endpoints in mySCADA myPRO Manager allows unauthenticated remote takeover of industrial management functions.
items.reason_zh: mySCADA myPRO Manager 的特权 API 端点缺失身份验证，允许未经身份验证的攻击者远程接管工业管理功能。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded cryptographic server key in Wärtsilä FOS-Onboard compromises secure update channels, enabling malicious firmware deployment to OT systems.
items.reason_zh: Wärtsilä FOS-Onboard 中硬编码的加密服务器密钥危及安全更新通道，使攻击者能够向 OT 系统部署恶意固件。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded cryptographic client key in Wärtsilä FOS-Onboard undermines mutual authentication, risking unauthorized device integration and control.
items.reason_zh: Wärtsilä FOS-Onboard 中硬编码的加密客户端密钥破坏了相互认证机制，增加未经授权的设备集成与控制风险。

items.reason_en: Kalkitech communication test set improperly validates TLS certificates in IEC 60870-5-104 clients, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks against critical SCADA protocols.
items.reason_zh: Kalkitech 通信测试仪在 IEC 60870-5-104 客户端中未正确验证 TLS 证书，使攻击者能够对关键 SCADA 协议实施中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: A logic flaw in OpenBMC's IPMI implementation allows attackers to replace authorization contexts while retaining encryption keys, enabling unauthorized hardware management commands on BMC-managed servers.
items.reason_zh: OpenBMC 的 IPMI 实现中存在逻辑缺陷，允许攻击者在保留加密密钥的情况下替换授权上下文，从而在 BMC 管理的服务器上发送未授权的硬件管理命令。

items.reason_en: Lite-On devices expose an OS command injection vulnerability via the NETCONF M-Plane interface, allowing authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands on ICS management planes.
items.reason_zh: Lite-On 设备通过 NETCONF M-Plane 接口暴露 OS 命令注入漏洞，允许已认证用户在 ICS 管理平面上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Hidden functionality in Lite-On products permits arbitrary OS command execution via SSH enable mode, bypassing intended security controls and enabling full device takeover.
items.reason_zh: Lite-On 产品中的隐藏功能允许通过 SSH enable 模式执行任意 OS 命令，绕过预期安全控制并实现设备完全接管。

items.reason_en: Secomea GateManager suffers from a session fixation vulnerability, enabling attackers to hijack administrative remote monitoring sessions and gain unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Secomea GateManager 存在会话固定漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞劫持管理员远程监控会话并获取未授权访问权限。

items.reason_en: SAML IdP response manipulation in Delinea Secret Server enables user impersonation, severely compromising privileged access management and session integrity.
items.reason_zh: Delinea Secret Server 中的 SAML IdP 响应篡改漏洞可导致用户冒充，严重破坏特权访问管理和会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Reflected XSS via malicious links in Delinea Secret Server allows attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript in victim browsers, facilitating credential theft or session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Delinea Secret Server 中通过恶意链接触发的反射型 XSS 漏洞允许攻击者在受害者浏览器中执行任意 JavaScript 代码，从而便于窃取凭证或劫持会话。

items.reason_en: Padding oracle attack in Delinea Secret Server facilitates unauthorized data encryption and decryption without exposing master cryptographic keys, undermining secrets management.
items.reason_zh: Delinea Secret Server 中的填充预言机攻击可在不泄露主加密密钥的情况下实现未授权的数据加解密，削弱了机密信息管理的安全性。

items.reason_en: Authentication-dependent DoS in Atlassian Confluence Data Center can disrupt collaboration platforms and cause operational downtime even for authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: Atlassian Confluence Data Center 中存在依赖认证的拒绝服务（DoS）漏洞，即使对于已认证用户也可能导致协作平台中断及业务停机。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized users to circumvent security features and access sensitive project data over networks.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在授权绕过漏洞，允许未授权用户绕过安全功能并通过网络访问敏感项目数据。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion vulnerability in ASP.NET Core can lead to denial-of-service attacks against web applications handling high traffic loads.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞可能导致针对处理高流量负载的 Web 应用程序的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows remote code execution. It bypasses access controls on widely deployed web collaboration platforms, enabling unauthorized system access.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的缺失授权漏洞可允许远程代码执行。该漏洞绕过了广泛部署的 Web 协作平台的访问控制，使攻击者能够未授权访问系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.3 cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates attacker spoofing and session hijacking. While lower severity, it remains highly exploitable for credential theft and phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中 CVSS 评分为 7.3 的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞便于攻击者进行欺骗和会话劫持。尽管严重程度较低，但仍极易被利用于凭证窃取和网络钓鱼活动。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 external control of file path in .NET allows remote privilege escalation. Framework-level path validation weaknesses can be chained to achieve deeper system access beyond initial boundaries.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中 CVSS 评分为 7.5 的文件路径外部控制漏洞可导致远程权限提升。框架层面的路径验证缺陷可被组合利用，以突破初始边界实现更深层次的系统访问。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge allows remote code execution via malicious web content, underscoring persistent browser exploitation risks.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Microsoft Edge 存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过恶意网页内容实现远程代码执行，凸显了浏览器持续面临的利用风险。

items.reason_en: Incomplete comparison flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass security controls over the network, compromising developer environments and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 不完整比较缺陷允许未认证的攻击者通过网络绕过安全控制，危及开发环境和 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery enables attackers to interact with internal network resources from the development environment, facilitating lateral reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: 服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞使攻击者能够从开发环境访问内部网络资源，便于进行横向侦察。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling creates parsing inconsistencies that can be leveraged to bypass web application firewalls or inject malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞会导致解析不一致，攻击者可借此绕过 Web 应用防火墙（WAF）或注入恶意载荷。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability allows unauthorized access to restricted directories, potentially exposing source code or configuration files to attackers.
items.reason_zh: 路径遍历漏洞允许未授权访问受限目录，可能导致源代码或配置文件暴露给攻击者。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges, jeopardizing enterprise content management and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者提升权限，危及企业内容管理和协作平台的安全。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables network spoofing, creating direct pathways for targeted phishing and credential harvesting campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可实现网络欺骗，为定向网络钓鱼和凭证收集活动提供直接途径。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in Exchange Server allow privilege escalation, exposing sensitive corporate communications and mail infrastructure to unauthorized control.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中缺失的授权检查可导致权限提升，使敏感的企业通信和邮件基础设施面临未授权控制的风险。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted deserialization in Cotonti Comments plugin enables unauthenticated PHP object injection and arbitrary code execution on web servers.
items.reason_zh: Cotonti Comments 插件中存在不受限制的反序列化漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者在 Web 服务器上注入 PHP 对象并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated file reading via unsanitized parameters in @zereight/mcp-gitlab exposes sensitive server-side data to external actors.
items.reason_zh: @zereight/mcp-gitlab 中通过未过滤参数实现的未认证文件读取漏洞，会将敏感的服务器端数据暴露给外部实体。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Fireshare video upload function allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite critical system files and compromise hosting.
items.reason_zh: Fireshare 视频上传函数中存在参数注入漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者覆盖关键系统文件并破坏托管环境。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation in webpros components permits arbitrary file overwrites via symlink attacks, leading to potential web shell deployment.
items.reason_zh: webpros 组件中验证不足的问题允许通过符号链接攻击实现任意文件覆盖，可能导致 Web Shell 部署。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated X-GitLab-API-URL header in @zereight/mcp-gitlab facilitates phishing and API endpoint redirection attacks against development workflows.
items.reason_zh: @zereight/mcp-gitlab 中未经验证的 X-GitLab-API-URL 请求头便于针对开发工作流发起网络钓鱼和 API 端点重定向攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite Purchasing module allows low-privileged HTTP exploitation, risking supply chain and procurement data exposure.
items.reason_zh: Oracle E-Business Suite 采购模块中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的漏洞允许低权限攻击者通过 HTTP 进行利用，存在供应链和采购数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: High severity (8.8) in Contract Lifecycle Management exposes public sector contract data to unauthorized network access via HTTP, impacting compliance and operational workflows.
items.reason_zh: 合同生命周期管理（Contract Lifecycle Management）中严重性较高（8.8）的漏洞使公共部门合同数据面临通过 HTTP 进行的未授权网络访问风险，影响合规性与运营流程。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 in Bills of Material setup workbench allows low-privileged attackers to compromise manufacturing and inventory configurations over HTTP, disrupting production planning.
items.reason_zh: 物料清单（Bills of Material）设置工作台 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的漏洞允许低权限攻击者通过 HTTP 破坏制造和库存配置，干扰生产计划。

items.reason_en: Critical web-based flaw (8.8) in Oracle Contracts enables low-privileged HTTP exploitation, jeopardizing contractual agreements and financial transaction processing.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Contracts 中严重性极高的基于 Web 的缺陷（8.8）允许低权限攻击者通过 HTTP 进行利用，危及合同协议和财务交易处理。

items.reason_en: Provides unauthenticated HTTP access to Oracle BI Publisher, enabling attackers to directly compromise the web application and exfiltrate sensitive analytics data.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞为 Oracle BI Publisher 提供未认证的 HTTP 访问权限，使攻击者能够直接入侵 Web 应用程序并外泄敏感分析数据。

items.reason_en: Leverages personalization features in Oracle Applications Framework to allow low-privileged attackers to execute unauthorized actions over HTTP.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞利用 Oracle Applications Framework 中的个性化功能，允许低权限攻击者通过 HTTP 执行未授权操作。

items.reason_en: Exposes the Helidon microservices framework to easy network-based exploitation, threatening modern Java-based cloud applications.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞使 Helidon 微服务框架易于遭受基于网络的利用，对现代基于 Java 的云应用程序构成威胁。

items.reason_en: A critical 9.9 CVSS flaw allows low-privileged attackers to easily compromise Oracle BI Enterprise Edition via HTTP, risking full analytics platform takeover.
items.reason_zh: 关键性CVSS评分为9.9的漏洞允许低权限攻击者通过HTTP轻易入侵Oracle BI Enterprise Edition，可能导致整个分析平台被完全接管。

items.reason_en: High-privileged attackers can exploit HTTP-based flaws in Oracle BI Publisher to compromise the platform, threatening sensitive business intelligence data.
items.reason_zh: 高权限攻击者可利用Oracle BI Publisher中的基于HTTP的漏洞入侵该平台，威胁敏感的商业智能数据。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable via HTTP, this vulnerability compromises the Siebel CRM Management Console, potentially allowing unauthorized administrative control.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞可通过HTTP轻易利用，导致Siebel CRM Management Console被入侵，可能使攻击者获得未授权的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged attackers can exploit HTTP requests targeting Oracle E-Business Suite personalization features, leading to potential system compromise.
items.reason_zh: 低权限攻击者可利用针对Oracle E-Business Suite个性化功能的HTTP请求，导致系统潜在的被入侵风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers can easily compromise Siebel Financial Services via HTTP, exposing critical financial customer data and workflows.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的攻击者可通过HTTP轻易入侵Siebel Financial Services，导致关键金融客户数据和业务流程泄露。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP exploitation allows direct compromise of WebCenter Portal Composer tools, severely impacting public-facing intranets and web application integrity.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的HTTP利用可直接导致WebCenter Portal Composer工具被入侵，严重危及面向公众的内网及Web应用完整性。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable HTTPS vulnerability enables low-priv attackers to compromise Siebel CRM deployment infrastructure remotely, risking sensitive client data exposure.
items.reason_zh: 易于利用的HTTPS漏洞使低权限攻击者能够远程入侵Siebel CRM部署基础设施，存在敏感客户数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP access allows attackers to compromise the iStore shopping cart module, directly threatening e-commerce transaction processing and checkout workflows.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的HTTP访问可使攻击者入侵iStore购物车模块，直接威胁电子商务交易处理与结账流程。

items.reason_en: Low-priv HTTP exploitation compromises the Oracle Report Manager web interface, potentially enabling unauthorized data extraction or remote system takeover within E-Business Suite.
items.reason_zh: 低权限HTTP利用可导致Oracle Report Manager Web界面被入侵，可能在E-Business Suite中实现未授权的数据提取或远程系统接管。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged network access via HTTP enables full compromise of Oracle WebCenter Portal Composer, posing a critical risk to enterprise web applications.
items.reason_zh: 通过HTTP的低权限网络访问可导致Oracle WebCenter Portal Composer被完全入侵，对企业Web应用构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: HTTP-based exploitation allows attackers to compromise Oracle WebCenter Sites, threatening content delivery and user data integrity across supported versions.
items.reason_zh: 基于HTTP的利用可使攻击者入侵Oracle WebCenter Sites，威胁受支持版本的内容分发与用户数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated blind SQL injection in J2Store allows extraction of sensitive customer records, order data, and stored credentials from Joomla storefronts.
items.reason_zh: J2Store中存在未认证的盲注SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可从Joomla商店中提取敏感的客户记录、订单数据及已存储的凭据。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file read vulnerability in J2Store's download task exposes sensitive digital assets and configuration files without authentication.
items.reason_zh: J2Store下载任务中存在任意文件读取漏洞，无需认证即可暴露敏感的数字资产和配置文件。

items.reason_en: libwebsockets HPACK header parsing flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution via out-of-bounds writes, threatening widespread WebSocket deployments.
items.reason_zh: libwebsockets的HPACK头解析缺陷允许通过越界写入实现未认证的远程代码执行，对广泛的WebSocket部署构成威胁。

items.reason_en: http4s Ember server accepts conflicting Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length headers, facilitating HTTP request smuggling attacks behind reverse proxies.
items.reason_zh: http4s Ember服务器接受冲突的Transfer-Encoding和Content-Length头，易在反向代理后方遭受HTTP请求走私攻击。

items.reason_en: Flextype CMS REST API lacks proper parameter validation, allowing authenticated attackers to traverse directories and overwrite critical application files.
items.reason_zh: Flextype CMS REST API缺乏适当的参数验证，允许已认证的攻击者遍历目录并覆盖关键应用程序文件。

items.reason_en: WordPress Design Scuole Italia theme contains a path traversal vulnerability enabling unauthenticated attackers to download sensitive server files.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Design Scuole Italia主题存在路径遍历漏洞，使未认证的攻击者能够下载敏感的服务器文件。

items.reason_en: Tornado web framework ignores duplicate chunked transfer-encoding headers, enabling HTTP request smuggling and cache poisoning when deployed behind reverse proxies.
items.reason_zh: Tornado Web框架忽略重复的chunked transfer-encoding头，在部署于反向代理后方时易引发HTTP请求走私和缓存投毒。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Flowise AI's Custom MCP node allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary system commands by injecting malicious npx package names into configuration parameters.
items.reason_zh: Flowise AI的Custom MCP节点存在远程代码执行漏洞，已认证用户可通过向配置参数注入恶意的npx包名来执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Critical flaws in Cisco Secure Email Gateway and Web Manager platforms could permit remote code execution or service disruption, directly impacting enterprise communication security postures.
items.reason_zh: Cisco Secure Email Gateway和Web Manager平台的关键缺陷可能导致远程代码执行或服务中断，直接影响企业通信安全态势。

items.reason_en: The Authorizer authentication server accepts any redirect_uri without validation, enabling token theft, phishing attacks, and complete authentication bypass for integrated OIDC/OAuth applications.
items.reason_zh: Authorizer认证服务器在未经验证的情况下接受任意redirect_uri，可导致令牌窃取、钓鱼攻击，并使集成的OIDC/OAuth应用完全绕过身份验证。

items.reason_en: The proxy-addr Node.js module incorrectly handles IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnets, allowing attackers to spoof client IP addresses in Express applications and bypass security controls.
items.reason_zh: proxy-addr Node.js模块错误处理IPv4映射的IPv6信任子网，允许攻击者在Express应用中伪造客户端IP地址并绕过安全控制。

items.reason_en: WHMCS deserializes untrusted data without proper validation, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on hosting management and billing servers.
items.reason_zh: WHMCS在未进行适当验证的情况下反序列化不受信任的数据，使远程攻击者能够在托管管理和计费服务器上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Tutor LMS WordPress plugin suffers from PHP object injection via an unsanitized AJAX parameter, allowing unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges or execute code.
items.reason_zh: Tutor LMS WordPress插件因未清理的AJAX参数存在PHP对象注入漏洞，使未认证的攻击者能够提升权限或执行代码。

items.reason_en: A web application contains an unauthenticated OS command injection in its ping.php endpoint, granting immediate remote code execution to any internet-facing instance.
items.reason_zh: 某Web应用在ping.php端点中存在未认证的OS命令注入漏洞，任何面向互联网的实例均可被立即获取远程代码执行权限。

items.reason_en: Netty incorrectly parses quoted strings in HTTP/1.1 chunked transfer encoding extension values, facilitating request smuggling attacks against reverse proxies and load balancers.
items.reason_zh: Netty错误解析HTTP/1.1分块传输编码扩展值中的引号字符串，易导致针对反向代理和负载均衡器的请求走私攻击。

items.reason_en: Improper validation of HTTP/2 pseudo-headers in gRPC-Go enables unauthenticated routing bypass, granting unauthorized access to protected services.
items.reason_zh: gRPC-Go中对HTTP/2伪头的验证不当，可导致未认证的路由绕过，从而未经授权访问受保护的服务。

items.reason_en: Flaw in urllib3's chunked response handling can lead to memory corruption or denial of service when processing crafted HTTP headers.
items.reason_zh: urllib3的分块响应处理缺陷在处理构造的HTTP头时可能导致内存损坏或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in Casdoor's MCP endpoint allows any client credentials to bypass isolation controls and fully compromise multi-tenant user administration.
items.reason_zh: Casdoor的MCP端点存在关键授权缺陷，允许任何客户端凭据绕过隔离控制，完全入侵多租户用户管理。

items.reason_en: Authentication logic flaw discards current password verification, enabling attackers to reset any user account password remotely.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证逻辑缺陷丢弃了当前密码验证，使攻击者能够远程重置任何用户账户的密码。

items.reason_en: Sandbox escape in PraisonAI code execution mode allows malicious scripts to access restricted Node.js globals and achieve full remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: PraisonAI 代码执行模式下的沙箱逃逸漏洞允许恶意脚本访问受限的 Node.js 全局变量，从而实现完全的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SOAP receiver in OpenAM allows attackers to persist malicious entries in discovery stores, potentially disrupting authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: OpenAM 中无需认证的 SOAP 接收器允许攻击者在发现存储中持久化恶意条目，可能破坏认证基础设施。

items.reason_en: Authenticated SQL injection in Joomla SP Page Builder content plugin allows attackers to manipulate database queries, extract sensitive data, or modify site configurations.
items.reason_zh: Joomla SP Page Builder 内容插件中的需认证 SQL 注入漏洞允许攻击者操纵数据库查询、提取敏感数据或修改站点配置。

items.reason_en: Mass assignment flaw in SPIP CMS allows unauthenticated attackers to directly insert arbitrary rows into any unprotected database table, compromising data integrity.
items.reason_zh: SPIP CMS 中的批量赋值漏洞允许未认证攻击者直接向任何未受保护的数据库表插入任意数据行，从而破坏数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Remote SQL injection in SourceCodester faculty clearance system allows attackers to manipulate database queries, potentially exposing sensitive academic records.
items.reason_zh: SourceCodester 教职工审批系统中的远程 SQL 注入漏洞允许攻击者操纵数据库查询，可能导致敏感学术记录泄露。

items.reason_en: Critical unauthenticated RCE via T3/IIOP protocols in Oracle WebLogic Server compromises core middleware infrastructure and backend application services.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server 中通过 T3/IIOP 协议存在的无需认证关键远程代码执行漏洞会破坏核心中间件基础设施及后端应用程序服务。

items.reason_en: HTTP-based vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server Web Container allows full system compromise across widely deployed enterprise middleware versions.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server Web 容器中的基于 HTTP 的漏洞可导致广泛部署的企业中间件版本被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated compromise of Oracle Net Services exposes database connectivity layers to remote exploitation, risking data exfiltration and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Net Services 无需认证即可被利用，使数据库连接层暴露于远程攻击之下，存在数据外泄和横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Flaw in Oracle Platform Security for Java central jars enables unauthenticated network attacks against enterprise authentication and authorization services.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Platform Security for Java 核心 JAR 包中的缺陷可启用针对企业认证与授权服务的无需认证网络攻击。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server permits remote attackers to execute arbitrary code without proper authentication checks.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中对不受信任数据进行不安全的反序列化操作，允许远程攻击者在缺乏适当身份验证的情况下执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaw in Microsoft SQL Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate underlying database structures.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者提升权限并操纵底层数据库结构。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 deserialization flaw in SQL Server permits remote code execution. Database engines are critical assets, and this vulnerability directly threatens data integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.1 的反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。数据库引擎是关键资产，该漏洞直接威胁数据的完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Dynamics 365 allows remote code execution. It exposes enterprise resource planning systems to full compromise without proper input sanitization.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。由于缺乏适当的输入清理，该漏洞使企业资源计划系统面临完全被控的风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in the SQL OLE DB provider enables remote code execution. This undermines database connectivity layers and query processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: SQL OLE DB 提供程序中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，进而破坏数据库连接层与查询处理流程。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges remotely, jeopardizing database integrity and sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程提权，危及数据库完整性与敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, potentially leading to complete server takeover through crafted input payloads.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，通过精心构造的输入载荷可能引发服务器被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in SQL Server permits remote privilege escalation, weakening access controls and increasing the risk of unauthorized data manipulation.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中权限管理不当可导致远程提权，削弱访问控制机制，增加未经授权数据操作的风险。

items.reason_en: Injection vulnerability in SQL Server allows unauthenticated network code execution, directly threatening database integrity and enabling complete server takeover.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的注入漏洞允许无需认证的网络代码执行，直接威胁数据库完整性，并可导致服务器被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the database engine permits authenticated remote code execution, risking data exfiltration and persistent backdoors in production databases.
items.reason_zh: 数据库引擎中的释放后使用漏洞允许已认证远程代码执行，存在数据外泄和生产数据库植入持久化后门的风险。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely, destabilizing database services and compromising stored data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行代码，破坏数据库服务稳定性并导致存储数据受损。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the database engine can lead to memory corruption and remote code execution, affecting query processing and middleware reliability.
items.reason_zh: 数据库引擎中的整数溢出可导致内存损坏与远程代码执行，影响查询处理流程及中间件可靠性。

items.reason_en: Remote heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code directly on the database host.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的远程堆溢出漏洞允许未认证攻击者在数据库主机上直接执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in SQL Server enables unauthorized data extraction, modification, and privilege escalation within the database environment.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞可在数据库环境中实现未经授权的数据提取、修改及权限提升。

items.reason_en: Remote heap-based buffer overflow compromises SQL Server stability and integrity, allowing potential remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: 远程基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞会破坏 SQL Server 的稳定性与完整性，允许通过网络实施潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in SQL Server creates path traversal risks that could lead to unauthorized file access or configuration tampering.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中链接解析不当会产生路径遍历风险，可能导致未经授权的文件访问或配置被篡改。

items.reason_en: Local heap overflow in SQL Server poses a privilege escalation risk if an attacker gains an initial foothold on the database host.
items.reason_zh: 若攻击者在数据库主机上获得初始立足点，SQL Server 中的本地堆溢出将带来提权风险。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable HTTP vulnerability in Oracle Hyperion Financial Management allows unauthenticated remote compromise of financial data systems.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Financial Management 中易于利用的 HTTP 漏洞允许未认证攻击者远程控制财务数据系统。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft SQL Server enables unauthenticated network code execution, directly threatening database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现无需认证的网络代码执行，直接威胁数据库完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: Application server vulnerability in Oracle Agile PLM permits unauthenticated HTTP-based compromise of supply chain management platforms.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Agile PLM 中的应用服务器漏洞允许通过 HTTP 进行无需认证的利用，致使供应链管理平台被控。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure Cosmos DB allows authenticated users to perform spoofing attacks against other tenants or shared resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中的授权绕过漏洞允许已认证用户对其他租户或共享资源发起欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Critical CVSS score of 9.9 allows unauthenticated network compromise of Oracle Hyperion Financial Management, posing severe risk to financial data integrity and system availability.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分高达9.9（严重级别），允许未认证的攻击者通过网络入侵Oracle Hyperion Financial Management，对财务数据完整性和系统可用性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Extremely high severity (9.6) enables unauthenticated attackers to exploit physical segment access vulnerabilities, potentially leading to full system takeover and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: 极高严重性（9.6）使未认证攻击者能够利用物理网段访问漏洞，可能导致系统完全沦陷及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.1 vulnerability permits unauthenticated HTTP-based attacks against Oracle Hyperion, directly compromising critical financial management functions without prior authentication.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.1漏洞允许针对Oracle Hyperion发起未认证的HTTP攻击，无需预先认证即可直接破坏关键财务管理功能。

items.reason_en: High-risk (9.1) flaw allows privileged attackers to compromise the system via Oracle Net protocol, threatening backend middleware operations and enterprise resource planning stability.
items.reason_zh: 高风险（9.1）缺陷允许特权攻击者通过Oracle Net协议入侵系统，威胁后端中间件操作及企业资源规划稳定性。

items.reason_en: Allows low-privileged attackers with DB Link rights to escalate privileges and fully compromise the Oracle RDBMS, posing a severe risk to enterprise data integrity.
items.reason_zh: 拥有DB Link权限的低权限攻击者可提升权限并完全控制Oracle RDBMS，对企业数据完整性构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Enables low-privileged network attackers to compromise Oracle Coherence middleware via HTTP, potentially disrupting distributed caching and application performance.
items.reason_zh: 允许低权限网络攻击者通过HTTP入侵Oracle Coherence中间件，可能破坏分布式缓存机制及应用性能。

items.reason_en: Exploits a flaw in Oracle Identity Manager’s security module, allowing low-privileged attackers to bypass authentication controls and compromise identity services.
items.reason_zh: 利用Oracle Identity Manager安全模块中的缺陷，使低权限攻击者能够绕过身份验证控制并破坏身份管理服务。

items.reason_en: Allows low-privileged attackers to compromise the Oracle Database RDBMS via network access using DBMS_REDEFINITION privileges, posing a severe risk to core database integrity.
items.reason_zh: 允许低权限攻击者利用DBMS_REDEFINITION权限通过网络访问入侵Oracle Database RDBMS，对核心数据库完整性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Enables low-privileged attackers with Create Index rights to compromise Oracle Database Server through the vulnerable Text component over Oracle Net.
items.reason_zh: 拥有Create Index权限的低权限攻击者可通过Oracle Net利用Text组件的漏洞入侵Oracle Database Server。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit HTTP requests against JDeveloper's Resource Catalog Services to compromise the middleware environment.
items.reason_zh: 未认证攻击者可利用针对JDeveloper Resource Catalog Services的HTTP请求入侵中间件环境。

items.reason_en: Attackers can leverage HTTP traffic to compromise the Helidon framework's MongoDB client integration, impacting application connectivity and security.
items.reason_zh: 攻击者可利用HTTP流量破坏Helidon框架的MongoDB客户端集成，影响应用连接性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Critically high severity flaw in Oracle Internet Directory's LDAP server; easily exploitable by low-privileged network attackers, risking complete directory compromise and authentication bypass.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Internet Directory的LDAP服务器存在极高严重性缺陷；低权限网络攻击者易于利用，可能导致目录服务完全沦陷及身份验证绕过。

items.reason_en: Enables low-privileged attackers with basic table creation rights to compromise the Oracle Database Server engine via Oracle Net, directly threatening core data integrity and availability.
items.reason_zh: 允许拥有基础建表权限的低权限攻击者通过Oracle Net入侵Oracle Database Server引擎，直接威胁核心数据的完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable via HTTP by low-priv users, jeopardizing centralized Fusion Middleware control and potentially allowing unauthorized configuration changes or deployment overrides.
items.reason_zh: 低权限用户可通过HTTP轻松利用该漏洞，危及Fusion Middleware集中管控，并可能导致未经授权的配置更改或部署覆盖。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote exploitation via HTTP affects widely deployed enterprise application servers, posing significant risks to internal business logic and legacy system access.
items.reason_zh: 通过HTTP进行的未认证远程利用影响了广泛部署的企业应用服务器，对内部业务逻辑及遗留系统访问构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: HTTP-based exploitation of Oracle WebLogic Server's TopLink Integration allows low-privileged attackers to achieve complete middleware compromise.
items.reason_zh: 基于HTTP利用Oracle WebLogic Server的TopLink Integration可使低权限攻击者实现中间件的完全控制。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible HTTP vulnerabilities in Oracle Managed File Transfer enable unauthorized compromise of secure file exchange infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Managed File Transfer中可网络访问的HTTP漏洞导致安全文件交换基础设施遭未授权入侵。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in IBM MQ allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on application servers handling message queues.
items.reason_zh: IBM MQ中对不可信数据的反序列化允许已认证攻击者在处理消息队列的应用服务器上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL forwarding in Anyquery permits remote attackers to attach arbitrary databases and exfiltrate sensitive data via SQLite.
items.reason_zh: Anyquery中的未认证SQL转发允许远程攻击者附加任意数据库并通过SQLite窃取敏感数据。

items.reason_en: IBM MQ processes unsafe JNDI lookups when IVT applications are deployed, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via deserialization chains.
items.reason_zh: 部署IVT应用程序时，IBM MQ会处理不安全的JNDI查找，允许远程攻击者通过反序列化链执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: IBM MQ deserialization vulnerability enables remote code execution for authenticated attackers, risking complete middleware compromise.
items.reason_zh: IBM MQ的反序列化漏洞使已认证攻击者能够实现远程代码执行，面临中间件完全沦陷的风险。

items.reason_en: IBM Db2 improper file path validation allows remote attackers to perform arbitrary file writes, potentially overwriting configuration or log files.
items.reason_zh: IBM Db2的文件路径验证不当允许远程攻击者执行任意文件写入，可能覆盖配置文件或日志文件。

items.reason_en: ArcadeDB schema mutation methods lack adequate authorization checks, allowing unauthorized users to alter database structures and bypass security policies.
items.reason_zh: ArcadeDB的模式变更方法缺乏充分的授权检查，允许未授权用户修改数据库结构并绕过安全策略。

items.reason_en: Missing DNS rebinding protection and security settings in the MySQL MCP Server's SSE transport configuration allows unauthenticated attackers to perform SSRF attacks against internal database services.
items.reason_zh: MySQL MCP Server的SSE传输配置中缺失DNS重绑定防护及安全设置，允许未认证攻击者对内网数据库服务发起SSRF攻击。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized sessionId parameters in Flowise AI's MongoDBMemory node enable unauthenticated attackers to inject MongoDB operators and exfiltrate sensitive chat history from other users.
items.reason_zh: Flowise AI的MongoDBMemory节点中未过滤的sessionId参数使未认证攻击者能够注入MongoDB运算符，窃取其他用户的敏感聊天记录。

items.reason_en: OpenAM accepts arbitrary Java classes via pre-authentication XML callbacks, allowing instant remote code execution before user verification completes.
items.reason_zh: OpenAM通过预身份验证XML回调接受任意Java类，使用户验证完成前即可立即实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: OpenAM concatenates unescaped MSISDN values into LDAP search filters, enabling authentication bypass and directory traversal in identity management deployments.
items.reason_zh: OpenAM将未转义的MSISDN值拼接到LDAP搜索过滤器中，在身份管理部署中可导致身份验证绕过及目录遍历。

items.reason_en: Apache Artemis lacks authentication for critical federation functions, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to force brokers to connect to rogue targets.
items.reason_zh: Apache Artemis的关键联邦功能缺乏身份验证，允许未认证远程攻击者强制Broker连接到恶意目标。

items.reason_en: OpenDJ's JMX RMI connector processes credential objects before authentication, exposing directory services to unauthorized access and potential privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: OpenDJ的JMX RMI连接器在身份验证前处理凭据对象，导致目录服务暴露于未授权访问及潜在权限提升风险之下。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in c3p0 connection pooling allows remote code execution via malicious Java objects or JNDI references.
items.reason_zh: c3p0连接池的不安全反序列化允许通过恶意Java对象或JNDI引用实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Legacy JNDI functionality in mchange-commons-java enables remote code execution through malicious factory class loading.
items.reason_zh: mchange-commons-java中的遗留JNDI功能可通过恶意工厂类加载实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated database connection string injection in pgweb allows attackers to bypass access controls and connect to arbitrary backend databases.
items.reason_zh: pgweb中无需身份验证的数据库连接字符串注入漏洞可使攻击者绕过访问控制并连接到任意后端数据库。

items.reason_en: Authorization check bypass in IBM App Connect Enterprise enables remote authenticated users to circumvent security restrictions and access restricted resources.
items.reason_zh: IBM App Connect Enterprise中的授权检查绕过漏洞使远程已认证用户能够规避安全限制并访问受限资源。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable vulnerability in Oracle MySQL Group Replication plugin allows remote attackers to disrupt cluster synchronization or execute unauthorized operations.
items.reason_zh: Oracle MySQL组复制插件中存在易被利用的漏洞，允许远程攻击者破坏集群同步或执行未授权操作。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated RDP vulnerability in Oracle VM VirtualBox Core allows remote compromise of virtualized desktop environments and isolated lab setups.
items.reason_zh: Oracle VM VirtualBox Core中存在无需身份验证的RDP漏洞，可导致虚拟化桌面环境和隔离实验环境被远程攻陷。

items.reason_en: SQL injection logic flaw in Microsoft Discovery Studio risks sensitive data disclosure in specialized scientific and engineering research workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Discovery Studio中的SQL注入逻辑缺陷可能导致专业科研与工程工作流中的敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Visual Studio development environment enables remote code execution when processing malicious project files.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio开发环境中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，在处理恶意项目文件时可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows Management Instrumentation allows local attackers to elevate privileges by exploiting memory corruption during system queries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Management Instrumentation中的释放后使用漏洞允许本地攻击者在系统查询期间利用内存损坏来提升权限。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Active Directory Domain Services enables remote code execution, threatening core enterprise identity and access management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services中的释放后使用漏洞可实现远程代码执行，威胁企业核心身份与访问管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass by spoofing in Windows Netlogon allows adjacent attackers to impersonate domain controllers, undermining Kerberos trust relationships and network security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Netlogon中的欺骗型身份验证绕过漏洞允许相邻攻击者冒充域控制器，从而破坏Kerberos信任关系和网络安全。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Hyper-V hypervisor allows authorized attackers to execute code locally, potentially breaking VM isolation and compromising host systems.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V虚拟机监视器中的非受信指针解引用漏洞允许已授权攻击者在本地执行代码，可能破坏虚拟机隔离并危及主机系统。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Microsoft Authenticator allows local privilege escalation, undermining multi-factor authentication controls and account recovery mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator中的身份验证不当漏洞可导致本地权限提升，削弱多因素认证控制及账户恢复机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the IDE allows unauthenticated network code execution, posing a significant risk to software development lifecycles and build servers.
items.reason_zh: IDE中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现无需身份验证的网络代码执行，对软件开发生命周期和构建服务器构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in font rendering components can be triggered remotely via malicious web pages or documents, leading to system instability and potential code execution.
items.reason_zh: 字体渲染组件中的堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意网页或文档远程触发，导致系统不稳定及潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Premature session acceptance in emp3r0r C2 framework bypasses CBOR authentication, allowing unauthenticated remote command execution.
items.reason_zh: emp3r0r C2框架中的会话过早接受漏洞可绕过CBOR认证，实现无需身份验证的远程命令执行。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged attacker can compromise Oracle VM VirtualBox infrastructure, potentially destabilizing hosted virtual machines and host systems.
items.reason_zh: 低权限攻击者可攻陷Oracle VM VirtualBox基础设施，可能导致托管虚拟机和宿主机系统运行不稳定。

items.reason_en: High-privileged attackers can exploit T3 and IIOP protocols to compromise Oracle Agile PLM, disrupting supply chain lifecycle management.
items.reason_zh: 高权限攻击者可利用T3和IIOP协议攻陷Oracle Agile PLM，破坏供应链生命周期管理。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged attackers with infrastructure logon access can easily compromise Oracle Product Lifecycle Analytics during installation processes.
items.reason_zh: 具有基础设施登录权限的低权限攻击者可在安装过程中轻易攻陷Oracle Product Lifecycle Analytics。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged attackers can exploit HTTP traffic to compromise Oracle Banking Corporate Lending Process Management, risking sensitive financial operations.
items.reason_zh: 低权限攻击者可利用HTTP流量攻陷Oracle Banking Corporate Lending Process Management，危及敏感金融业务。

items.reason_en: Compromise of core banking corporate lending modules impacts critical financial operations, requiring immediate patching despite initial physical segment access constraints.
items.reason_zh: 核心银行对公贷款模块被攻陷将影响关键金融业务，尽管初始受物理网段访问限制，仍需立即修补。

items.reason_en: Local infrastructure logon allows compromise of PeopleSoft financial inventory tracking, disrupting enterprise resource planning and supply chain management workflows.
items.reason_zh: 本地基础设施登录权限可导致PeopleSoft财务库存跟踪被攻陷，破坏企业资源计划和供应链管理流程。

items.reason_en: HTTP-based exploitation by low-priv users threatens branch-level financial reporting accuracy and operational security across specialized banking networks.
items.reason_zh: 低权限用户发起的基于HTTP的攻击将威胁分行级财务报告的准确性及专用银行网络的运营安全。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated physical segment access via Oracle Identity Manager Connectors allows attackers to compromise core identity provisioning services.
items.reason_zh: 通过Oracle Identity Manager Connectors进行无需身份验证的物理网段访问，可使攻击者攻陷核心身份配置服务。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible HTTP exploitation in Oracle GraalVM compiler components threatens Java runtime integrity across development and deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Oracle GraalVM编译器组件中可网络访问的HTTP攻击漏洞将威胁开发与部署流水线中的Java运行时完整性。

items.reason_en: Case-sensitive path filtering in MCPVault fails to canonicalize filesystem paths, enabling directory traversal attacks against local vaults.
items.reason_zh: MCPVault中区分大小写的路径过滤未能规范化文件系统路径，从而导致针对本地保险库的目录遍历攻击。

items.reason_en: OriginLab Origin Viewer heap-based buffer overflow enables remote code execution upon opening malicious OGM files, targeting scientific visualization software.
items.reason_zh: OriginLab Origin Viewer中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞在打开恶意OGM文件时可导致远程代码执行，该漏洞针对科学可视化软件。

items.reason_en: Red Hat rsyslogd crashes due to flawed oversized-frame recovery in the imptcp module, causing denial of service in critical logging infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat rsyslogd因imptcp模块中大帧恢复逻辑缺陷导致崩溃，引发关键日志基础设施拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: CodeRAG dependency synchronization flow incorrectly validates build scripts, creating supply chain risks for AI coding agents and automated development pipelines.
items.reason_zh: CodeRAG依赖同步流程错误验证构建脚本，为AI编程代理和自动化开发流水线带来供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow during IRAP file parsing due to missing size validation in Surfio poses a high exploitation risk when untrusted files are processed in networking or web server contexts.
items.reason_zh: Surfio在解析IRAP文件时因缺少大小验证导致缓冲区溢出，在网络或Web服务器环境下处理不受信任文件时具有极高的利用风险。

items.reason_en: Tesseract OCR's GenericVector callback reads int32 fields without capacity checks, leading to potential buffer overflows and crashes when processing untrained or malicious model files.
items.reason_zh: Tesseract OCR的GenericVector回调在未进行容量检查的情况下读取int32字段，在处理未训练或恶意模型文件时可能导致缓冲区溢出和程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Bouncy Castle's BC-JAVA core contains a covert timing channel in cryptographic operations, potentially leaking sensitive encryption keys through side-channel analysis.
items.reason_zh: Bouncy Castle 的 BC-JAVA 核心模块在密码学操作中存在隐蔽计时通道，可能通过侧信道分析泄露敏感加密密钥。

items.reason_en: Bouncy Castle implements a broken or risky cryptographic algorithm variant, weakening data confidentiality across affected Java applications relying on legacy cipher modes.
items.reason_zh: Bouncy Castle 实现了存在缺陷或高风险的密码算法变体，削弱了依赖传统密码模式的受影响 Java 应用程序的数据机密性。

items.reason_en: WSO2 Integrator VS Code extension executes unit tests from untrusted projects without input sanitization, enabling OS command injection during the development workflow.
items.reason_zh: WSO2 Integrator VS Code 扩展插件在未对输入进行清理的情况下执行来自不受信任项目的单元测试，从而在开发工作流中触发操作系统命令注入漏洞。

items.reason_en: Insecure password reset mechanism in LIBRID/LIBREF allows attackers to exploit forgotten password flows and gain unauthorized access to library systems.
items.reason_zh: LIBRID/LIBREF 中的密码重置机制存在安全缺陷，攻击者可利用该机制绕过忘记密码流程，从而获取对图书馆系统的未授权访问权限。
